data.name: Motiram
data.gender_notes: Motiram is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Moti means 'jewel' and Ram means 'God'. Motiram is a name that symbolizes wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. In Hindu mythology, Motiram is associated with Lord Vishnu and is believed to bring wealth and abundance to one's life. The name Motiram carries the meaning “God of wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Motiram usually hope their child will grow to embody god of wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Name of the God of wealth in Hinduism
data.etymology: Motiram belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of wealth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Motiram total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

Overall, Motiram is a name that signifies good fortune and success.
